Audio Trim Silence

Automatically detect and trim leading/trailing silence from audio, then export WAV.

✂️ Drop an audio file here or click to browse
Anything quieter than this counts as silence.
Shorter quiet bits are kept.

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an audio file into the tool.
  2. Set the silence threshold and minimum silence length.
  3. Detect silence, then click Download WAV.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is silence detected?

It scans from each end for the first sample louder than your threshold (in dB), ignoring silences shorter than your minimum.

How do I tune the detection?

Set the threshold in dB and the minimum silence length in seconds, then press Detect.

What format is the download?

A 16-bit PCM WAV of the trimmed audio; the result shows exactly how much was removed from each end.
